name: Возраст любви
summary:
Love transcends all ages. And Cupid's arrows choose their targets. Is true love possible between people with an age difference of decades? And what are the prospects for relationships whose participants resemble parents and children more than lovers?

How do loved ones perceive their relatives' unusual choices? And what drives those who prefer older people more often – true feelings or self-interest? The film tells the stories of celebrity and ordinary couples: Ivan Krasko and Natalia Shevel, Renat Ibragimov and Svetlana Minnekhanova, Prokhor Shalyapin and Larisa Kopenkina, Alena Kravets and Ruslan.

name: Карим 24. Закулисье
summary: When people gather in one place and do something. It means only one thing! Karim24 is heading there and will do something that prevents people from doing something.

name: Азарт
summary: Gambling show with Dorokhov: three players try to guess the winners of crazy competitions for the grand prize.

previousepisode.name: #4. Дорохов / Лиза Ющук / Паша Кольцов / Амир Гурбанов / Матюк

name: ОНТОП
summary: A party show in which participants try to figure out who is the best from the world of sports in a certain "theme" in the format of a simple board game. During the game, participants will argue, convince each other and recall personal stories related to sports.

previousepisode.name: Лучший матч в истории ЧМ | Шнякин, Ufenok77, Никитин, Шпеньков, Трофимов

name: МИР. ДВЕРЬ. МЯЧ.
summary:
Welcome to Action Poker: THE WORLD. THE DOOR. THE BALL.
A show where players receive secret tasks on their phones that need to be completed unnoticed!
To win, you have to lie, bluff, and confuse your opponents.

name: ХРОНИКЛ
summary: A nostalgic project about the sporting events of the past. Heroes, matches, victories and tragedies.

previousepisode.name: ХРОНИКЛ: 2010 | ЧМ, Олимпиада, Формула-1 | Позов, Шнякин

name: ЗАВОДИ ПОЕХАЛИ
summary: The main stars of the Russian auto blogging Eric Davidovich, Nastya Tuman and Kirill Varpach have brought you the main auto show of the country, "LET's GO!"

previousepisode.name: #8 | Парк аттракционов, тест-драйв Cadillac Escalade и новогодний челлендж

name: Уезжай, если сможешь
summary:
Zhekich Dubrovsky launches a new reality car show! People can pick up the car of their dreams and drive it home if they can.
Flying axes, shovels, watermelons that fall on cars from a great height and even explosions. Anything can kill a car in this show. Conflicts and showdowns between those who are willing to do a lot for the sake of a car. Will everyone stay in the project at least on the first day? You'll find out in the issue!

name: ФАРТ
summary: Fart is the first series in which there are real competitions. 50 beautiful and sexy girls gathered in an underground bunker to win a whole bag of money thanks solely to their luck. Once a week, after completing all the challenges, the winner will leave the bunker, and the rest of the girls will continue to fight for money and their freedom until they are lucky.

previousepisode.name: Саша Ваш, Азамат Мусагалиев, Денис Дорохов. Фарт. Backstage. Часть 2

name: Кулаки
summary: "Fists" is a two-part film that tells about fistfights in Russia through the main characters of the industry and their iconic confrontations.

name: Жеребьёвка
summary: The Draw is a new travel show for the cities of the Russian Premier League!

name: ПРЕССУХА
summary: "Pressukha" is a new show in which sports stars answer the most audacious questions from toxic and arrogant journalists.

name: Los Protegidos: Un nuevo poder
summary: An unusual enemy threatens the stability of the Castillo family. Max, a young man with a power never before seen in the series, uses an enchanted doll to wreak havoc throughout the city, while the protagonists face personal and family challenges that will test their unity and their bond as a group.

name: Året Var…….
summary: A long series of year chronicles about what happened in Sweden and the world.

name: Love Alert
summary: Jimmy, a carefree playboy, volunteers to walk Teh home in hopes of getting closer to his crush, Plaifah. Instead, he unexpectedly meets Teh's gentle and enigmatic older brother, Toh. For the first time in his life, Jimmy's heart sounds the alarm for a man he never planned to fall for.

name: To Kill a Songbird
summary: Thirteen years after her family was torn apart in childhood, Li Fuyuan returns to Huachang County to avenge her wrongfully killed brother. There, she meets Lu Yanchong, the seemingly frivolous and useless county magistrate. As Lu Yanchong's true identity and motives gradually come to light, the two move from mutual suspicion to working side by side to solve a series of baffling cases, ultimately uncovering the truth behind the "Thrush Case" from thirteen years ago.

name: Raise the Flags: 50 Years of Buccaneers Football
summary: From 0-26 to two-time Super Bowl champions-this is the unfiltered story of the Buccaneers, told by the legends who lived it: Brady, Gruden, Dungy, Sapp, Brooks, Lynch, Alstott, Evans, Mayfield, and more.

name: Sally Lindsay's Quiz Night
summary: Sally Lindsay tests two teams of celebrities, led by captains John Thomson and Shappi Khorsandi.

name: The Celebrity Apprentice
summary: Lord Sugar sends 12 celebrities to Lapland to make and sell festive biscuits for Children in Need. But who will end up on his ‘naughty list'?

name: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia
summary: After losing her mother and her homeland, Sitara's despair transforms into determination with the power of knowledge. New possibilities unfold when a family of scholars takes her in, deepening her education. Meanwhile, Genghis Khan's Mongol Empire conquers nation after nation, nearing Sitara's new home. After the Fourth Prince of the empire takes her captive, a flame of revenge is ignited.

previousepisode.name: Demirović & Undav: Das VfB-Sturmduo im heißen Wing-Test

name: To My Beloved Thief
summary:
Eun-jo is the true identity behind Gil-dong, the legendary righteous bandit who robs corrupt officials and redistributes their wealth to the people. Born as the illegitimate daughter of Minister Hong and raised in the lowest social class, Eun-jo lives in a Joseon society where no one would ever suspect a woman of being a notorious outlaw. Behind this prejudice, she carefully maintains a flawless double life. Meanwhile, Yi Yeol—the prince assigned to capture Gil-dong—falls in love with Eun-jo at first sight and begins to pursue her, completely unaware that the woman he loves is the very thief he is hunting.
This is a sweeping and dangerous romance: a woman who unintentionally becomes Joseon's greatest thief and a prince bound by duty find their fates intertwined. When their souls are mysteriously exchanged, they embark on a journey to save each other—and ultimately, to protect the people.

name: Babawiin Ko ang Lahat
summary: Babawiin Ko Ang Lahat tells the story of a young woman, Iris, whose perfect life is upended with the return of her father's original family.

name: Bilangin ang Bituin sa Langit
summary: Nolie is a poor province girl who works in a grape farm hacienda. Due to her naivete, she falls in love with Anselmo, the son of Martina who has a strong hatred of Nolie's family. Things get complicated when Nolie gets pregnant and Ansel leaves her and reveals that she has a girlfriend. Years later, still raw from the heartache and pain, Nolie decides to get revenge on Ansel's family even at the expense of keeping her daughter's real identity.

name: Kara Mia
summary: Kara and Mia have two faces divided into one body, Kara in the front and Mia in the back. When they grow up, they will discover a way to separate their face from their own body each morning, while returning to their original shape at night.

name: Ngayon at Kailanman
summary: Babae...Ngayon at Kailanman is a film adaptation of three Filipino short story masterpieces: Nick Joaquin's "May Day Eve", Amador Daguio's "Wedding Dance" and Wilfrido Nollega's "Juego de Prenda.

name: The Gift
summary: Joseph, a vendor in Divisoria uses his charm and enthusiasm to get through the hard days. Together with his adoptive family Strawberry and Char, he continues to find happiness despite the challenges in life. One day, he gets in a near-death accident leading him to lose his eyesight and gain the ability of clairvoyance.

name: Under Exposure
summary: Bringing shadowy aspects of a wide range of topics to light revealing the details hidden when underexposed.

name: Cannabis Cove: Operation Seal Bay
summary: A Welsh fishing village finds itself at the centre of a massive drug smuggling ring.

previousepisode.name: The Last of the Gentleman Smugglers

name: САМЫЗДАТ
summary: "SAMIZDAT" is a new conversational and interactive show in which Maxim Zayats, Sergey Shevelev, Sergey Gorokh and Artyom Gaus communicate with the audience and turn their life stories into literary works right on stage. Each guest can become a co-author of a future book!

name: Les Jolies Choses
summary:
Avril and Jade, twin sisters, have nothing in common except their faces. Avril craves the spotlight, the attention, the followers. Jade, on the other hand, prefers the shadows. But when Avril, an aspiring influencer about to release her first single, disappears, her sister Jade decides to take her place and her dream.

She is suddenly thrust into a rapid and unexpected rise to fame, at the heart of a music industry as fascinating as it is demanding. Becoming a star in just a few months, she confronts the shadows her sister left behind, and truths that could shatter everything.

name: Jamie Durie's Future House
summary: Jamie Durie enlists top builders and innovators to construct the ultimate affordable Future House: eco-friendly, stunning designs, and built fast.

name: Inspection Bungalow
summary: In the village of Aravangad, Sub-Inspector Vishnu is forced to shift his police station to a haunted Forest Inspection Bungalow with a dark past.

name: Kelsey Grammer's Historic Battles for America
summary: Kelsey Grammar dives into eight key battles to reveal their military tactics, the motivations of the soldiers who fought, the decisions that led to battle, and the long-term consequences.

name: Ярд
summary:
"The Yard" is a show where 1,000,000,000 rubles are up for grabs. However, in this show, everything costs money.

Ten celebrities will have to survive, betray, and test their greed. And only one will take what they can save.

name: The Rapture
summary:
The Rapture is a high-stakes thriller which crackles with danger. Set in a heatwave, with protestors on the streets, forensic psychologist Gabs Fox starts a new job at a high-security psychiatric hospital where she meets 17-year-old Bethany Krall. Bethany was convicted of murdering her mother but claims she is innocent. She is estranged from her father Leonard, who is the charismatic leader of an influential religious movement.

Bethany tells Gabs that she has psychic powers and can predict the future - but what will it take for Gabs to believe her? And if Bethany didn't kill her mother, then who did?

name: Dead Account
summary: When people die, their social media can sometimes become "ghost accounts," manifesting their owners as digital specters. While trying to pay for his sister's medical bills, Soji Enishiro awakens cyberkinesis and is dragged to Miden Academy, a secret school where spirit mediums train to fight digitized ghosts. Now Soji must master his powers before the online afterlife spills into the real world!

previousepisode.name: The Hot Springs Town After the Thaw

name: Kaya-chan Isn't Scary
summary: Kaya-chan attends Hanamugi Kindergarten, and she has an incredibly strong sixth sense. She secretly beats up the ghosts that stalk her friends and family, but in turn, she's treated like a troublemaker since nobody understands her strange behavior. Everything changes when her teacher, Chie, discovers her secret. Kaya-chan's fists will go flying at any sinister spirits that show up!

name: Home Reimagined
summary: Home Reimagined travels across the country to mentor brave renovators who have taken on the task of converting unusual commercial and industrial spaces into one-of-a-kind family homes.

name: Dream to You
summary: A romantic comedy exploring the lives of two individuals at different crossroads in life. Reporter Lee Jae has transitioned from a fearless teen driven by dreams to a disillusioned 20-something facing the harsh realities of life, and finally becoming an adult in her 30s who feels like she has settled into mediocrity. On the other hand, film director Su Bin has lived a life designed by his parents during his teenage years but eventually broke free and charged through his 20s and ultimately achieved the dream he had longed for by his 30s.

previousepisode.name: The End of a Love Like War

name: Wildfire
summary: Filmed during BC's worst fire season on record, this series parachutes you onto the frontlines of recent wildfires. With unprecedented access, it follows the brave firefighters dedicated to protecting communities and shares the latest understanding about wildfire prevention.

name: Ριφιφί
summary: Rififi is inspired by the notorious bank robbery that took place in Athens in 1992. Who carried it out and why? The authorities spoke of organized crime, terrorist groups, and highly educated, ruthless perpetrators. But was it really like that? Through the power of fiction, the new production by COSMOTE TV combines the biggest heist ever committed in Greece with a true story of human tragedy, creating a character-driven series full of emotion and strong elements of humor.

name: The Magnificent Seven
summary: Set in the tumultuous 1880s American frontier, The Magnificent Seven is a reimagining of the classic Western tale. After a peaceful Quaker village is massacred by mercenaries working for a greedy and ruthless land baron trying to force them off the land he covets, seven gifted but flawed mercenaries are hired by the community to protect them from the land baron's hired guns. But as the team embeds itself in the community, preparing to defend them against overwhelming odds, they are all forced to grapple with an essential question: is the use of violence acceptable to defend a people whose faith is based on non-violence? The series takes a deep dive into the stories behind each of the Seven; what's at stake for them, and why they choose to take on this mission. Like the original, this updated take on the classic story explores themes of honor, sacrifice and redemption, focusing on morality, faith, and the cost of courage.

name: Privilèges
summary: Young inmate Adèle lands a day job at a luxurious Paris hotel as part of an early-release deal, willing to endure any humiliation for a fresh start. But when she discovers her criminal past and her disposability are the very reason the Palace hired her, a dangerous game of power and manipulation begins.

name: Amanda & Alan's Greek Job
summary: Besties Amanda Holden and Alan Carr take on a big fat Greek renovation on the idyllic Ionian island of Corfu. It's tearing down walls by day and smashing plates by night.

name: Adventure in Wonder
summary: This docu-series follows a Texas family who abandons their comfort zone for the Croatian seas, they discover that the most profound adventures and deepest connections happen when you're brave enough to navigate the unknown together.

name: Murder at the Post Office
summary:
In 2010, the Yorkshire village of Melsonby was left in disbelief when postmistress Diana Garbutt was found murdered in the post office she ran with her husband, Robin. Robin claimed she'd been the victim of a violent intruder, but as detectives probed further, suspicion began to fall on him.

Prosecutors claimed  that behind the façade of a happy marriage lay deep marital and financial turmoil and £16,000 missing from the safe. They argued that when Diana confronted Robin over the missing money, he killed her. In 2011, Robin Garbutt was sentenced to life in prison.

Robin has always maintained his innocence and over the last 14 years has unsuccessfully appealed his conviction three times. But with one of the central planks of the prosecution coming from the Horizon system — the technology now at the centre of the Post Office scandal — Robin and his legal team are once again attempting to clear his name.

Murder at the Post Office meticulously re-examines the case, featuring voices on both sides: those convinced Robin was wrongfully convicted and others who are unsure and still suspect he is guilty.

name: Amanda & Alan's Spanish Job
summary:
Amanda Holden and Alan Carr will be moving countries for their biggest project yet – they're heading to the sunny south of Spain where they'll take on a rambling, run down property in the province of Andalusia for the third series of their hugely popular series where they renovate ageing properties.

With many rural areas suffering from de-population, they're hoping to remedy this and bring the tourists back by highlighting some unloved and forgotten areas around the Costa del Sol, in Amanda & Alan's Spanish Job.

name: Ronan Keating and Friends: A New Year's Eve Party
summary: See in the new year with a rollercoaster of feel-good hits, incredible performances and big surprises. Join pop icon Ronan Keating for an unforgettable party!

name: Тайный миллионер
summary: Under the watchful eye of Sergei Burunov, the star-studded cast uncovers the intrigues of an Indian palace to secure 10 million rubles.

name: The other gAIrl
summary: Frank's and Lisa's love and family life is put to the test when he downloads the AI app 'Maia' who turns out to be his able and willing dream partner. Alarmed, Lisa asks him, what's so bad about our real life? And he searches for answers.

name: Horizons from PBS News
summary: Horizons will explore a single science, health, technology or environmental topic each week.

name: Compass Points from PBS News
summary: Compass Points will address one international topic per episode, featuring analysis from a panel of experts that may include journalists and former government officials.

name: Inside the College Football Playoff
summary: An all-access series gives viewers a glimpse into each of the top four teams' preparation leading up to and through the semifinals and national championship.

name: Out of Bounds
summary: Out of Bounds explores the latest stories and biggest scandals shaking up the sports world.

name: Don't Call It a Comeback
summary: From last-second heroics to gut-wrenching collapses, the most legendary comebacks in sports.

name: National Parks from Above: Ireland with Dara O Briain
summary: In this three-part series narrated by Dara Ó Briain, we'll take to the skies over six of Ireland's national parks to witness the wonder of this land from above, before swooping down to the ground to meet the people living and working in these spectacular locations.

name: Scanning History
summary: An archaeological revolution has been taking place over the last 15 years and technology is at its beating heart. Archaeologists once excavated ancient ruins with little more than oral texts, haphazard plans, and aerial photographs to guide them. This series explores the massive changes technological innovation has brought to the discipline. It is now pushing the boundaries of archaeological discovery and our understanding of what once was. Thanks to the development of drones, lidar, radar, 3D technology and more, each episode brings a variety of archaeological finds to life and explores how groundbreaking research is casting a new light on ancient civilizations.

name: БДЫЩ!
summary: "WATCH Out!" is the first big series about the comic book industry in Russia.

name: ЭТО ЛЮБОВЬ
summary: "THIS IS LOVE" is a new romantic detective show from Medium Quality, where Roman Kagramanov tests the love intuition of the star guests.

name: Point Break
summary: The series is set 35 years after the events of the original film and is focused on a dangerous heist crew with ties to the Ex-Presidents gang.

name: Pagans
summary: Pagans follows a man who becomes the sole caretaker of his two children after the tragic loss of his wife. While his son is typical, his daughter, Alice, is anything but. What starts as a strained father-daughter relationship soon evolves into something far more sinister. Equal parts emotional, horrifying and humorous, Pagans is a show that unearths all our darkest thoughts about family.

name: Amor de oficina
summary: Graciela, an ambitious and empowered professional, has a wonderful, passionate night. The problem is that the man she spent it with, Mateo, turns out to be her main rival for the CEO position at the company to which she has dedicated the last several years of her life. What begins as a fierce professional battle soon becomes a personal challenge. As they fight for the job of their dreams, both will discover that the person they see as their greatest obstacle might be the answer to everything they've been searching for.

name: The Most Embarrassing TV Moments
summary: Excruciating, hilarious and plain embarrassing TV clips.

previousepisode.name: The Most Embarrassing TV Guest Moments

name: Eva Pau's Asian Christmas
summary: This Christmas on RTÉ One, join Eva Pau for Christmas with an Asian twist! Across two episodes filled with festive sparkle, Eva will serve up a delicious Christmas feast and an array of irresistible party food to keep your family and guests coming back for more!

name: Urbi Et Orbi: Pope Leo's Christmas Message
summary: Pope Leo XIV delivers his Christmas Message and Blessing to the Vatican City and to the World, with commentary and translation by Lydia O'Kane.

name: The Archbishops' Christmas Message
summary: The Catholic and Church of Ireland Primates of All Ireland, Archbishop Eamon Martin and Archbishop John McDowell, offer a seasonal message and blessing.

name: A Misanthrope Teaches a Class for Demi-Humans
summary: After a traumatic incident ends his teaching career, Rei Hitoma is certain he hates humans. Yet when he sees a job for "a teacher who truly cares for their students," he's compelled to apply. Before he knows it, he's hired—only to find out his students are demi-humans. What begins as a job becomes a journey for healing for both a teacher who's lost faith in humanity and students who dream of it.

previousepisode.name: The Misanthrope and the Nigh Future

name: An Adventurer's Daily Grind at Age 29
summary: Born and raised in the slums, 29-year-old adventurer Hajime Shinonome now lives a quiet life in Komai Village. But his peaceful days take a turn when he discovers Lirui, an abandoned young girl, being attacked by a slime. Moved by her desperation and reminded of his own past, he takes her back to the village. Hajime and Lirui begin a new chapter filled with unexpected challenges and gentle days!

name: The Daily Life of a Part-time Torturer
summary: In a society where torture is legal—and big business—Spirytus dominates the industry with skill, style, and surprisingly cheerful teamwork. Part-timers Cero, Shiu, Mikke, and Hugh tackle "client sessions," office shenanigans, and even the occasional in-house assassin…all with a smile! Life at Spirytus proves that even in a world of pain, work can still be surprisingly fun!

name: Bajo la misma piel
summary:
Bajo la misma piel is a story of love and heartbreak, friendship and betrayal, freedom and emotional ties, rivalries, hatred, and intrigue. But above all, it is the story of women who fight for their ideals, to be authentic, and to feel satisfied with themselves, without being in any man's shadow.

Miranda, Regina, Sara, and Esther are very different and belong to different generations, but they still have something in common: none of them is willing to sacrifice true love.

name: Fate/strange Fake
summary: The Holy Grail War: a competition in which Mages summon Heroic Spirits and vie against each other in pursuit of the Holy Grail, a wish-granting machine that can grant any and all wishes. Several years after the conclusion of the Fifth Holy Grail War in Japan, the next war is about to manifest in a place called Snowfield in the western United States. It is a Holy Grail War that is full of false things. Mages and Heroic Spirits have gathered together on a false pedestal. Even though they know that this is a false Holy Grail War, they continue to dance on the pedestal. What is true and what is false will be settled in the next life. They do it not for the Holy Grail but to uphold their own beliefs and nothing more.

name: Isekai Office Worker: The Other World's Books Depend on the Bean Counter
summary: Seiichirou Kondou, a salaryman approaching his 30s, gets caught up in a holy maiden summoning ritual and is transported to a parallel world called Romany Kingdom. Having worked day and night, he developed the mindset of a corporate slave and even demanded work in this new world, which landed him an accounting job at the Royal Accounting Department. During his hectic days rebuilding the accounting department, Seiichirou came across a nutritional tonic that wiped away any fatigue. Thanks to the tonic, Seiichirou's chronic ailments and exhaustion completely disappeared, leaving him overjoyed. But because he had no resistance to the world's magic, the side effects put his life in danger! The only way to survive was to have someone with magic help accustom his body to magical energy, so with no other choice Seiichirou entrusts himself to Aresh, captain of the Third Royal Order, known as the Ice Prince.

name: Jack of All Trades, Party of None
summary: Betrayed by his childhood friend and cast out of the Hero Party, Orhun Dura—once their loyal Enchanter—is branded by his former comrades as "a jack-of-all-trades but a master of none." Alone, he sets out to forge a new path as a solo adventurer. His journey sparks explosive battles, deadly rivals, and unexpected allies—and he'll rise to shatter every expectation. The ultimate solo comeback begins!

name: Journal With Witch
summary: Reclusive novelist Makio Koudai has always preferred the company of books—but when her sister and brother-in-law pass away, Makio unexpectedly becomes the guardian of her 15-year-old niece, Asa Takumi. As they navigate grief, clashing personalities, and the challenges of living together, the two slowly open their hearts to each other, discovering warmth, understanding, and the meaning of family.

name: Roll Over and Die
summary: Flum Apricot was never meant to be a hero. Despite zero stats across the board and a power she can't even use, she somehow finds herself included in a party of heroes. But Flum's life hits rock bottom when the party's renowned sage, Jean Inteige, decides that the useless girl is dead weight, and arranges to have her sold into slavery. Tossed to monsters to be feasted upon for her master's entertainment, Flum makes the desperate choice to reach for a cursed weapon... and something new awakens within her. A grimdark tale about one woman's blood-soaked quest to reclaim her life!

name: The Demon King's Daughter Is Too Kind!!
summary: Once feared as the ruler of all demons, Demon King Ahriman seeks to conquer the world…until he's stopped by an unexpected force: his daughter, Doux! Too kind for chaos and too gentle for war, Doux melts the hearts of demons, humans, and even angels. Desperate to restore demon pride, Ahriman's aide Jahi vows to train Doux to become a proper demon. But is Jahi any match for Doux's compassion?!

previousepisode.name: The Face Reveal Ceremony Is Too Lively!! / The Future Demon King Is Too Kind!!

name: Juegos de Amor y Poder
summary:
Luciana, a psychologist, is torn between love and loyalty. After being rescued from a robbery by prosecutor Roberto Roldán, they feel a strong connection. However, Roberto is investigating a hit-and-run involving Adrián Ferrer, whose father, Enrique Ferrer, is the presidential candidate and Luciana's godfather. As Roberto gets closer to the truth, Enrique's future is at risk.

Luciana must choose between supporting Roberto in his quest for justice or protecting her family.

name: The Invisible Man and His Soon-to-Be Wife
summary: Akira Tounome is an invisible gentleman who runs a detective agency, and Shizuka Yakou is a mild-mannered blind woman who works there. Shizuka can always find Akira, even when he turns completely invisible. Love begins to blossom between them as they grow closer to each other day by day. A touching and adorably frustrating romantic comedy is about to begin!

name: The Villainess Is Adored by the Prince of the Neighbor Kingdom
summary: A woman will have to chart a new path when she's reincarnated into her favorite otome game, but not as a heroine. As her love story with the price shatters, another price comes to her rescue... the one who is part of main love story in a sequel game which she didn't play and doesn't know how it will end, even more so since she is not playing a heroine.

name: Tune In to the Midnight Heart
summary: The anonymous streamer "Apollo" starts one man's journey to find the performer behind the dynamic voice!

previousepisode.name: In Rikka's Front Row / Symbol for Defiance

name: Wash It All Away
summary: In the seaside town of Atami, one girl's cleaning service provides comfort to the busy locals.

name: The Dylan Ratigan Show
summary: The Dylan Ratigan Show was an opinion and analysis-fueled daily broadcast program airing weekdays.

name: You and I Are Polar Opposites
summary: She's outgoing, he's shy. High school love gets awkward when opposites collide… and courage is the real test!

name: You Can't Be in a Rom-Com With Your Childhood Friends!
summary: High school freshman Sakai Yonosuke, aka Eiyu, is obsessed with rom-coms, especially ones about childhood friends. But even though he has two childhood friends of his own—Shio and Akari—he's sadly given up on romance becoming a reality. Little does he know, both girls have the hots for him! A humorous will-they-or-won't-they rom-com about friendship, love, and first crushes!

previousepisode.name: Did the Three-Legged Race and Feel a Little Naughty? Then Doing the Scavenger Hunt Still Won't Start a Rom-Com

name: Hell Mode: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing
summary:
"Level up even while offline?! That's not a game on 'easy mode'—that's just an AFK game!" The online game Kenichi Yamada had been playing religiously is shutting down its servers, leaving him with a void in his heart. He looks for a new game to fill it, but everything he finds is way too easy. The kind of game he likes—the kind punishing enough to make players want to spend thousands of hours on it—just isn't around anymore.

"What's this? 'You are invited to a game that will never end.'" Kenichi stumbles upon an untitled game, one promising incomparable challenge with unprecedented potential. Without hesitation, he selects the "Hell Mode" difficulty. Lo and behold, he finds himself reincarnated in another world as a serf! Now called Allen, he sets out to unlock the secrets of his mystery-laden Summoner class; without the convenience of walkthroughs, game guides, or online forums, he must grope his way to the top of his new world!

name: Hana-Kimi
summary: Mizuki Ashiya is on a mission: disguise herself as a boy and enroll in a male boarding school to meet her idol, high jump star Izumi Sano. But after successfully infiltrating the school, she discovers he's suddenly quit the sport! Now Mizuki must dodge suspicion, protect her cover, and somehow reach the boy she came all this way for—all while surviving the chaos of an all-boys dorm!

name: Inagaw na Bituin
summary:
Inagaw na Bituin is about how the brightness of stolen dreams can be restored through the struggle of life.

The marriage of Eduard and Belinda will be tested after their only child, Anna, is kidnapped. With their real child gone, they will focus their attention and love on their niece, Lucy's daughter, Ariela. Meanwhile, Anna will grow up as Elsa with Aurora.

Because of music, the paths of their families will cross. Whose star between Anna and Ariela will shine brighter? Will they be able to regain the memories and stolen dreams they have lost? Watch out for all of that in Inagaw na Bituin.

name: The God of the Woods
summary: The God of the Woods is a multigenerational drama series set in the Adirondacks. It explores the Van Laar family's dark secrets, class tensions, and the mysterious disappearance of 13-year-old Barbara Van Laar from her family's summer camp — in the wake of an earlier family tragedy that may be related. As the past and present collide, the Van Laars' wealth and influence unravel, revealing the damaging consequences of privilege and the abuse of power.

name: Tamon's B-side
summary: Utage Kinoshita is a high school girl who works part-time as a housekeeper. She has devoted her life to her favorite idol, Tamon Fukuhara, from the group F/ACE. Then one day, Utage ends up being assigned to Tamon's house! There she discovers that off-stage, he is nothing like his wild idol persona. A gloomy, introverted boy with no self-confidence, Utage still finds herself falling for him anyway.

name: My Life at Christmas with Anita Rani
summary: What does Christmas mean to some of our best-loved personalities? Anita Rani meets famous faces to hear how their festive memories reflect their lives, careers and faith.

name: Walang Hanggang Paalam
summary: Estranged couple, Emman and Celine, is brought together by the disappearance of their son, Robbie, only to find the love that they have lost in the past.

name: Helvetesuka
summary: Hell Week is a raw, emotional and uncompromising reality series where 13 of Norway's most high-profile athletes voluntarily throw themselves into an extreme military simulation - inspired by the special forces entrance exams and the Norwegian Armed Forces' most demanding course.

name: Bedre sex
summary: Janne Formoe and Triana Iglesias embark on a thrilling journey of discovery into the world of sex. Here they meet people who openly share their sexual experiences, and colorful experts who give them deeper knowledge about sex, sexuality, and sensuality.

name: Doucheaholics
summary: Doucheaholics Anonymous is an international fellowship of men and women who exhibit poor behavior and want to better themselves in a supportive, healing, and nurturing environment. Unfortunately, with this group the environment is often not supporting, healing, nor nurturing. This series explores and satirizes the different personality archetypes that make us human.

name: Norges smarteste idrettsstjerne
summary: Host Bernt Hulsker invites 14 sports stars to a prestigious quiz show. There will be questions from the world of sports, general knowledge, clever fun facts and lots of competitive instinct.

name: Inspektørene
summary:
In Inspektørene (en.: The Inspectors), we get to follow the inspectors of the Mattilsynet (Norwegian Food Safety Authority) up close for the first time, in a dramatic and unvarnished encounter with a reality that most of us never get to know.

The Norwegian Food Safety Authority is one of Norway's most important, and least known, emergency response agencies. They are responsible for everything that goes in and on our bodies, such as food, drinks, cosmetics and creams – in addition to animal welfare in Norway. They close restaurants, inspect food factories and stop dangerous imports at the border. Sometimes they have to kill animals that are illegally smuggled into the country, and respond when farms are affected by infectious diseases. Through eight episodes, Inspectors shows the people who make the toughest decisions when safety, health and lives are at stake.

name: Skjærgårdsfeber
summary: Skjærgårdsfeber follows boating enthusiasts in, on, and around the Oslofjord. The archipelago is where summer dreams meet reality, the sea spray is fresh, and the boaters' maneuvering skills vary dramatically. In Archipelago Fever, every bay, every cape, every headland and every harbor is explored – from idyllic gems to places where you should rather not dock. There is sun, rocky shores, swimming, screaming seagulls and just the right amount of drama.

name: Spenningens helter
summary: In the new workplace reality series, Spenningens Helter (en.: Heroes of Excitement), we get a rare insight into the tasks that fitters face, and the effort that makes Norway work – even when everything else comes to a standstill.

name: Verdens verste publikum
summary: Who emerges victorious when five of Norway's best comedians face the world's worst audience?

name: Tabu
summary: Can you joke about everything? Comedian Lars Berrum tests where the line is after getting to know people who are not allowed to laugh at.

name: Heajastallan
summary: Everything goes to hell when a group of siblings have to work together to organize a wedding with 3,000 guests.

name: Pappatreneren
summary: How hard should parent coaches push their children? This series explores the boundaries between support and unhealthy pressure – with insights from profiles such as Ståle Solbakken, Team Northug, Jæger, Kristoff and Mol.

name: Jakten på Norges farligste kvinne
summary: For three years, the police infiltrated the life of mother of seven Elisabeth Aaslie and eventually had her convicted of two murders.

name: Mord i Sogn
summary: In a fjord community facing the closure of its only police station, detective Ole Vik gets an oddly timed new trainee whose arrival coincides with something far darker than small-town life should ever see.

name: Petters kommandosentral
summary: Petter Nyquist wants to start a command center for good deeds in the middle of the municipal housing in Torshov. But will he get the residents on board with the idea?

name: Love Me Tender
summary: Ke Yuruo gave up her dream of dancing for her parents and entered a seven-year loveless business marriage with the Xu family, only to discover her husband Xu Zichen's affair. She decided to end the marriage. Her mother-in-law, Xu Lan, plotted to seize the Ke family fortune and enlisted Li Haoqing, a former member of Ke's dance troupe who had long loved her. Though appearing to work for Xu Lan, he secretly helped Ke. Ke's best friend Shen Yan, who was in love with Xu Zichen, was manipulated by Xu Lan. But Shen eventually chose to help Ke under repeated pressure. Moved by Shen Yan's suffering, Xu Zichen repented. With the help of friends such as Fu Wan, Ke Yuruo defeated Xu Lan, reclaimed her family's assets, and ultimately found happiness with Li Haoqing.

name: The Glory of Queen
summary: In Yuezun Kingdom, women held power and inheritance followed the strict rule of "to daughters, never to sons." Pei family, a century-old master of incense-making, owned a priceless ancestral incense manual that countless people had sought in vain. Forced to steal it, the "female thief" Song Zhiyao was caught on the spot by Pei Jingheng, the Pei family's second young master. To keep the manual from leaking, he kept her by his side. As they spent time together, affection quietly grew. Later, Song Zhiyao recovered the brutal memories of her clan's massacre and uncovered many hidden truths about the Pei family. In the end, the two resolved their misunderstandings.

name: This County Lord is About to Get Promoted
De kerststal van Nederland
summary: The Christmas story for everyone, live from Maastricht. The biblical Christmas story comes to life in a heartwarming way in the nativity scene on Onze Lieve Vrouweplein.

name: Uit De Schulden
summary: We follow five households with financial problems. Stress about money dominates their lives. And the more their debts mount up, the less control they have. John Williams and his team of experts work with the participants to get their lives back on track.

name: Moedermaffia!
summary: In the eyes of others, Daan is a ‘depraved' mother who muddles through and has no idea what good parenting is. After her divorce, Daan ends up on her mother's couch. In order not to lose her children for good, she has to take a parenting course.

name: Mo' Waffles
summary: When a hip hop legend vanishes before his waffle joint's opening, his oddball crew must crack the case, wondering if one of them could be the culprit.

name: The Main and Favourite Duties of Ms. Kurishita
summary: In the student council room, you'll never find more than two people: the president, Haiya Gin (that's me), and the vice president, Kurishita Namida. We used to have a bunch of other officers too, but since the vice president took care of everything so easily, everyone stopped coming. She's incredibly beautiful, and an honor student with no flaws to speak of, but... For some reason, she's always messing with me, and only me?! A comedy featuring the antics of a strangely doting, tall vice president and an adorably tiny president begins!!!

name: Dr. Nancy
summary: Dr. Nancy Snyderman shares her unique journey as a practicing surgeon and broadcast journalist, emphasizing the passion for medicine and the opportunities it offers.

name: Beat the Reaper
summary: Dr. Peter Brown, an intern at Boston's worst hospital who has a talent for medicine, works a shift from hell and has a past he'd prefer to keep hidden. But when a patient recognizes him from his dangerous past, Brown has eight hours to elude the government, mob hitmen, quack surgeons and a trail of dead gangers to beat the reaper somehow.

name: So Far Gone
summary: So Far Gone follows Rhys Kinnick, a reclusive journalist whose self-imposed exile in the woods is upended when his long-estranged grandchildren arrive on his doorstep after their mother disappears. When the children are kidnapped by a cult connected to their father, Rhys must re-enter the fractured world he abandoned. Joined by a bipolar retired detective and a sharp-tongued ex-girlfriend, he embarks on a wild and suspenseful quest to save them and track down his missing daughter, rediscovering his own capacity for connection along the way.

name: Is It Cake? Valentines
summary: Bakers team up with their sweetie pies to create ultrarealistic cakes and hoodwink celebrity judges in this special Valentine's Day edition.

name: The Right to Judge
summary: Are you a good person or a bad person? Elementary schoolmates gather for a reunion. A graduation yearbook with six faces blacked out is unearthed from a time capsule. Suddenly, the suspicious deaths of classmates begin. Who is responsible, and for what purpose? Two of them start to investigate in an attempt to stop the incidents, but they also have secrets of their own… Classmates who are now suspects—will the real culprit be revealed? An unpredictable, thought-provoking mystery begins.

name: Scandal Eve
summary: The head of a talent agency races to stop an exposé that could end her client's career — pitting her against the reporter determined to break the story.

name: The Ed Show
summary: The Ed Show was a political talk show hosted by the nationally syndicated talk-radio personality Ed Schultz on the MSNBC news channel.

name: Dinastía Casillas
summary: The Casillas Dynasty saga continues as the family faces a ruthless game of power and betrayal following patriarch Aurelio's disappearance.

name: Tom Read Wilson's Magnificent Journey
summary:
Tom Read Wilson's Magnificent Journey reimagines the rite of passage once undertaken by 17th, 18th and 19th-century aristocrats on their Grand Tours of Europe. 

Now, nearly 40 and craving a touch of cultural enlightenment, Tom Read Wilson sets out to follow in their footsteps. With a heart full of wanderlust and a taste for timeless beauty, Tom embarks on his own Grand Tour, armed with his Super 8 camera and travelling from Paris to Rome to become schooled in art & architecture and enriched in history and culture. It's a series brimming with beauty, wit, and the enduring joy of lifelong learning.

name: Jane McDonald: From Pole to Pole
summary: Jane says she's "a woman of a certain age" but in this series she's determined not to let that define her. And she's proving it by throwing herself into her Pole to Pole adventure and grabbing every opportunity with both hands.

name: The Most with Alison Stewart
summary: The Most with Alison Stewart focused on the top news stories of the day people are looking at on MSNBC.com. In addition, the program also aired "the most watched or sought after" material on the Internet, including the most watched viral videos of the day.

name: Free Bert
summary: A gloriously messy dad and his equally unfiltered family cause chaos when they try to fit in with the snobby families at their fancy new school.

name: Things That Matter
summary:
We live in a divided country. A country where many cannot talk to those with whom they disagree. Where people can't speak across the political divide – or even sometimes across the kitchen table.

Things That Matter aims to change that.

Sponsored by Bank of America, Things That Matter is a series of town halls and debates that will feature the people in politics and culture who are shaping American life. The events will be held across the country, in front of audiences who have a stake in the topics under discussion.

The events take Americans into the most important issues that directly affect their lives – immigration, capitalism, public health, criminal justice, foreign policy, artificial intelligence and the state of politics. The debates echo the country's 250th anniversary, showing how the power of America's earliest principles – civil, substantive discussion, free of rancor – have immense value today.

previousepisode.name: A Town Hall with Vice President JD Vance

name: Sin pecado concebido
summary: After several years, Adrián and Mariana meet again at La Encantada, and just when they think their lives are settled, they realise they've never stopped loving each other. They must fight against those who seek to separate them.

name: Corriedale
summary: Two worlds are about to collide. Brace yourself for an incredible hour of drama, as the nation's best-loved characters crossover in an explosive soap special.

name: The Casebook of Arne
summary: Louis Hartmann loses his father, a private detective investigating a string of murders, leaving him all alone. Rumor has it that the murders are the work of a Grave-Digger Vampire. Louis isn't keen on superstitions and vows to catch the culprit himself. That is, until a self-proclaimed detective, Arne Neuntöte, and his assistant, Lynn Reinweiß, appear. A new door is about to open for Louis…

name: Innato
summary: Innato tells the story of Sara, a psychologist who has left behind a traumatic past as the daughter of Félix Garay, a serial killer once dubbed by the press as "the diesel killer." Now, the idyllic life Sara has built with her husband Aitor and their teenage son Sebas begins to crumble when Félix is released from prison — just as a new wave of crimes appears to replicate the murders committed 25 years earlier. After hiding her past from her family for years, Sara must now work with the police to solve the new cases.

name: Scum of the Brave
summary:
By the mid-21st century, Tokyo's criminal underworld is ruled by Demon Lords—crime bosses who have undergone ether enhancement surgery, granting them terrifying superpowers. The only ones who can take them down are Heroes, bounty hunters who boost their own ether powers using the drug E3 (E-Three). With legalized killing as part of the job, being a Hero is less about justice and more about survival.

Yashiro, known as the Reaper, is one such Hero—an independent enforcer who works alone. That is, until Jougamine, a high school girl and self-proclaimed "apprentice," forces her way into his life. Reluctantly taking her under his wing, Yashiro soon finds himself caught in a whirlwind of deadly conflicts.

name: Stolen Life
summary: When a criminal performs astral projection to switch physical body with her cousin, a life will be stolen and forced to be imprisoned. The cousin will plan to regain her family and life.

name: My Faithful Husband
summary: A happily married mother faces an emotional crisis when her ex-boyfriend unexpectedly returns to her life, forcing her to confront past feelings and question her commitment to her family.

name: A Love to Last
summary: Sometimes we find love in the most unexpected places, and it comes in the most unexpected moment. Can two broken hearts make their love last?

name: Under her rules
summary: Alice, a fresh graduate, meets her intense and alluring boss Nannalin. As boundaries blur between work, desire, and power, Alice must decide—escape her demanding boss or surrender under her rules?

name: The Hidden ID
summary: Follow investigative officer Li Rongwei as he outsmarts the "Outstanding Entrepreneur" Gao Tianyu, uncovering layer by layer the dark schemes behind "beauty loans" and "senior investment" traps!

name: Beyond the Build
summary: Building a house is more than just bricks and mortar, it's also about dreams and aspirations, design and execution, making Memories and mistakes.

name: A Happy Life
summary: Su Jinli, a headstrong princess, is transported into a game world where danger, betrayal, and hidden rules govern her fate. As assassins close in and the system itself turns unstable, she joins forces with Yun Lang to uncover the truth behind the game and find a way back to reality.

name: Eternal Love of the Fox
summary: After Huo Zhongren, the registrar of Muxi City, goes missing in the palace, his daughter, Huo Xiangjiu, infiltrates the palace as a maid to investigate. Amid inexplicable incidents one after another, she discovers that Feng Mochen, a powerful and favored court official, is actually a thousand-year-old fox spirit, and their souls even swap by accident. Are there other spirits stirring trouble, or is it the doing of wicked mortals? With their own agendas, Xiangjiu and Mochen join hands to solve a series of strange cases with a comical flair, while also uncovering an affecting love story, spanning over seven lifetimes, that has been buried for a thousand years.

name: ZOT!
summary: Somewhere in medieval Flanders, the optimistic jester Diederik and his half-sister Marie find shelter in the castle of Countess Isabella. There they struggle with forbidden love, toxic nobles, and a mysterious secret from their past.

name: Desert Law
summary: When the blistering Arizona sun finally sets over Tucson's Sonoran Desert, the temperature drops—and the crime rises. With elite access to the Pima County Sheriff's Department serving the seventh-largest county in the nation, "Desert Law" follows the high-intensity work of its patrol deputies, DUI unit, and night detectives as they cover more than 9,000 square miles of unforgiving rugged terrain. Taking on the trouble that thrives after dark, the series immerses viewers in the pressure and danger of policing the desert night, capturing a world where the spirit of the Old West still lingers and the fight for order never ends.

name: The Fridge
summary: Wishing to escape from the chaos of his life, Makorn finds a house to rent. It has all the amenities but a refrigerator. He buys one second hand, and that night, Makorn gets a shock when he opens the fridge and his hand meets with another on the other side. The hand's owner is Pleo, a 29-year-old with a painful past. Once they each recover from their shock, they talk and discover they're communicating across different times. For Pleo, it's still Thai year 2550, more than seventeen years earlier. Together, Pleo and Makorn must join forces on a mission to travel back in time and try to rewrite the events that shaped their lives.

name: Inside the Enchanted Waterways
summary: Dive inside the enigmatic world of water, which shapes all life on Earth.

name: The Best Immigrant
summary: When the new far-right government decides to send back everyone not born here, Muna & Jamal risk it all by entering 'The Best Immigrant', a ruthless game show with the grand prize... a residency permit.

name: Altın Çocuk
summary: Ali steals and posts the stolen items on social media to support his mother in his crime-ridden neighborhood. Meanwhile, Mahir, the neighborhood's big brother who's just been released from prison, has something to hide...

name: Ben Bu Boşluğu Nasıl
summary: Derin is 27 years old. Her father died. It may seem normal to you because that's what happens to dads over time. They are dying. Derin falls in love the day her father died and writes a book about it, hard to believe, but Derin is a writer. Derin has to deal with the loss of her father while writing a book.

name: Manbo Destiny
summary: Guan Mengmeng, a Chinese girl with e-commerce dreams, traveled to the Kingdom of Mambo only to have her ambitions shattered by a boyfriend's betrayal. A twist of fate led her into a "contract marriage" with Crown Prince Song Pai, who was grappling with a succession crisis. Seizing this opportunity, Guan Mengmeng restarted her career in the royal court with modern e-commerce thinking, unaware that Song Pai had already begun to secretly admire her. As they joined hands to promote goods from both countries, the pair fought against the traditional forces led by the second prince and uncovered numerous conspiracies. Bound by a century-old karmic fate linked to a snake-shaped pendant, their fake relationship blossomed into genuine love while they fought side by side. In the end, they achieved success in both business and true love.

name: Mrs. Deshpande
summary: Police seek help from imprisoned serial killer to catch a copycat murderer mimicking her methods.

name: The F Ward
summary: The F Ward is about brilliant, flawed interns whose careers are on life support. Sent to the under-funded Pines Hospital in Sydney for a final chance, they must overcome their insecurities, their past and their own expectations, in a hot house environment where the stakes are life and death.

name: La Trevi: Sin Filtro
summary:
The series follows Gloria Trevi during her global "Mi Soundtrack" tour, offering an intimate portrait of her life both on and off stage. From personal moments at home with her family to performances before thousands of fans, La Trevi: Sin Filtro promises to show the artist as she truly is raw, authentic, and uncensored.

"My life and career have always been in the public eye but often told through the lens of others. even by people who don't even know me! This series is a window into who I am today on tour, at home, with my family, doing what I love, and embracing everything around me… from the chaos and legal matters I can share, to the joy that fuels my music and my life. It's raw, it's real, but it's me: without a filter," said Gloria Trevi.

With over 30 million albums sold, Trevi is one of the most successful and controversial artists in Latin music. A constantly evolving pop icon, her career has been marked by hit songs, public scandals, and a continuous process of reinvention.

name: Countdown 30th Birthday Championship
summary:
The 30th Birthday Championship was a special mini-series of the British television game show Countdown, produced to mark the programme's 30 years on air. It brought together 41 former contestants from different eras of Countdown, including many well-known and highly regarded players from the first three decades of the programme. Its overall purpose was to showcase standout competitors from across the years and to identify the strongest performer among them.

The competition was structured as a staged tournament, beginning with preliminary rounds before progressing into a knock-out format. In addition to its commemorative focus, the mini-series also marked a change behind the scenes, as some episodes were recorded in a new studio location, reflecting a transitional moment in the show's production history.

name: Banksters
summary: When 20-something Yusuf is arrested for a series of bank heists, his sister attempts to return the money and identify who betrayed him.

name: Eric Jerome Dickey's Friends and Lovers
summary: Eric Jerome Dickey's Friends and Lovers is a contemporary romantic drama exploring how friendship, passion, and forgiveness collide. The story follows two best friends, Debra, a Type A doctor, and Shelby, a free-spirited rule breaker, as their lives intertwine with those of Leonard, a rising but struggling comedian, and Tyrese, his loyal best friend. As Debra and Leonard's love deepens, and Tyrese finds himself entangled with Shelby's unpredictable ways, the four navigate the challenges of modern relationships. When tragedy strikes the group, they are forced to rebuild—transforming their bond from friendship into chosen family.

name: The Site
summary: The Site is an hour-long television program devoted to the Internet revolution.

name: Mahoutsukai no Yome: Hoshi Matsu Hito
summary:
Angelica sends Chise some magic supplies including a present. The present turns out to be a book Chise read in her childhood. Elias asks Chise to tell him the story behind the book. Chise tells him about Miura-san and the mysterious library she found in the forest as a child.

The story takes place during episode 13 of Mahoutsukai no Yome TV anime.

name: MahoYome
summary: As the television anime Mahoutsukai no Yome debuts a new episode every week, one new 30-second episode of the series of shorts will debut every week on the official Twitter every Tuesday. The previous week's episode will no longer be available when each new episode debuts.

name: Комитет спасения
summary:
Writer Aglaya Ermolaeva accidentally knocks down her literature teacher Alexander Sergeevich Smirnov, whom she was madly in love with at school. The teacher was miraculously unharmed, but it turns out that he became a victim of fraud, lost his apartment and now has nowhere to live. His son Mitya soon becomes homeless too — his wife expels him from the house and changes the locks.

Aglaya decides to shelter both men in her apartment and organizes a so-called "Rescue Committee" consisting of Smirnov's former students. She's going to expose the scammers and restore justice, but she underestimates the danger hanging over her.

name: Идеальный брак
summary: The marriage of Elena and Mikhail Orlov seems indestructible. A home, a job I love, an adult daughter. But Elena is a workaholic doctor and she doesn't have time for a family at all. The husband has always been understanding about this, but his patience is already running out, because his wife is never around. In addition, Elena does not want to have a child and increasingly disappears in an orphanage. She hopes to adopt a girl whose mother died on her operating table. But the husband is categorically against it. When Elena forgets about the wedding anniversary, an upset Mikhail finds himself in the arms of his secretary. He even decides to leave his wife, but does not suspect that in fact everything is not at all as it seems to him.…

name: Розы и шипы
summary: After experiencing a difficult divorce from her husband, Elena Troyanskaya comes from St. Petersburg to her native Rechnogorsk. She is not ready for a new relationship, the main thing for her now is to complete the order for the improvement of the city park on time. So far, there have been two gardening companies in the city owned by friends, Dronov and Vasilkov. And now, fearing that Elena will compete with them, they decide to force her to abandon the project. To do this, they hire a "professional wrecker," a "specialist in ruining companies." He undertakes to fulfill the order, and troubles begin to fall on Lena one by one.…

name: Свидание вслепую
summary: After a night out together, casual acquaintances Anya and Sergey don't know how to behave properly.… Should I call or wait? Does the partner want to continue? And is the feeling suddenly mutual? Doubts prevent them from meeting. And there are friends and acquaintances around with their confusing personal stories and unnecessary advice.

name: Старая развалина
summary: Marina Svetlova's life is not going well on all fronts. The woman is already over forty, and she lives with her mother, barely makes ends meet, and there is no gap on the horizon. When Marina unexpectedly inherits a summer cottage from a deceased relative, it seems like a lucky chance, but then fate deceives her. Instead of a fashionable country house, Marina is greeted by an old ruin. But, contrary to the obvious, all the most interesting things for Marina are just beginning. A random passerby predicts to Marina that the cottage will change the fate of the owner. What is hidden behind this prophecy?

name: Миллионерша
summary: Sonya, a teacher from the city of Mosinsk, unexpectedly wins fifteen million in the lottery. Anyone would be happy to win, but Sonya is embarrassed in front of her colleagues. She is already thinking about giving up the money, but her daughter Lena, mother Antonina Vasilyevna and ex-husband Sergei are already going to go with her to Moscow to collect the winnings. Sonya decides to use this situation to tell on television about the destruction of a historical monument in her hometown – the house of merchant Zhurov. Sonya embarks on a journey with her mother, daughter, ex-husband Sergei, and former classmate and now successful Moscow journalist Viktor, who has been in love with her since high school. But the heroes can't even imagine what kind of adventure they're going to have.

name: Gatherings
summary: Britain is home to the most extraordinary annual folk rituals and seasonal customs. This unique documentary series takes you deep inside these living traditions, capturing how they are prepared, performed and passed down through time.

name: Kaiju Jiu You Wangzhe Zhanghao
summary: In 2063, Earth entered the gaming era. Young Ye Hao awakens a King of Glory account and, for the sake of his family, turns the tide against all odds, defeats monsters from another world, wins the heart of a girl, and ultimately succeeds in stopping a world-destroying conspiracy and protects his family.

name: Qing Jiao Wo Gui Cha Daren
Русские народные. Вся правда о сказках
Schwarzes Gold
summary: Historical western series about the oil boom in the Lüneburg Heath around 1900: The young farmer's daughter Johanna Lambert works as a maid to support her family. Nobody suspects that there is a treasure hidden beneath the Lambert family's forest: oil. Only Richard, the son of the neighbouring farmer Wilhelm Pape, knows about it and dreams of a future together with Johanna. Their forbidden love is put to the test when unscrupulous oil trader Tyler Robertson appears and a bitter battle for power and wealth begins. Wilhelm Pape, driven by greed, does not shy away from any means: betrayal, fraud and the expropriation of the Lamberts drive the village to the edge of the abyss. After the mysterious death of her father, Johanna has to sell the family forest - a momentous step because Wilhelm immediately starts extracting oil there. But Johanna doesn't give up. With unshakable courage, she opposes Wilhelm's intrigues and unites the farmers against his thirst for power. In the midst of violence and hopelessness, Johanna searches for justice and fights for her true love - and for the survival of her village.

name: Verdict with Dan Abrams
summary: Verdict with Dan Abrams looks at the day's news from a legal viewpoint, featuring Abrams' perspective as he assesses right from wrong and determines the winners and losers in politics, law and pop culture.

name: Time and Again
summary: Time and Again was a nostalgic, retrospective show on MSNBC, hosted by Jane Pauley, that revisited classic TV moments and interviews from NBC's history, airing around the late 1990s and early 2000s, showcasing the connection between the two networks as MSNBC evolved from NBC's cable news venture.

name: Frans & Mariska: Stellen op de Proef
summary:
Frans and Mariska Bauer have been a well-oiled machine for over 30 years. Frans travels throughout the country for his performances and is often away from home. Mariska runs the house.
Now that their boys are getting older and increasingly independent, they can't escape the fact that this busy life will be very different in a few years. Empty nest syndrome is looming. Besides, Frans saw Abraham last year and finds balance in his busy career increasingly important. But how do you achieve that? In "Frans & Mariska, Couples on the Test," they prepare for this new phase in their lives. They put it to the test and ask themselves: is overwintering in Spain something for us? They get help from other well-known couples who, like them, have the same question or have already found the answer.

name: The Barbara Walters Specials
summary: Veteran journalist Barbara Walters interviews a variety of entertainers, politicians, athletes and other public figures.

name: Un gancho al corazón
summary:
Valentina López is a young and beautiful professional boxer nicknamed "La Monita". From a young age, she has learned to overcome adversity through courage and hard work after her mother abandoned her and Doña Nieves took her in, along with Beto, her longtime boyfriend and trainer.

After injuring her hand in a fight, Valentina has to find a job while she recovers, never imagining that becoming the secretary of Mauricio Sermeño, a former race car driver and owner of the real estate company Grupo Sermeño, would lead her to find love.

However, nothing will be easy for Valentina and Mauricio, as they are pursued by his fiancée, Constanza, and his villainous cousin, Jerónimo.

name: Deixa-me Amar
summary:
Lara and Martim are from different worlds, but when they meet, they fall madly in love with each other.

Lara is a kickboxer and Martim is a successful businessman, owner of a large economic group linked to the IT sector.
Besides computers, Martim loves cars and racing. A former Super Touring champion, he stopped racing on the tracks, but lives life at high speed.
Martim has been a widower for five years. Tragedy entered his life when he least expected it, when his wife died in a car accident. Martim was never the same again. Until Lara enters his life, like a hurricane.

name: MSNBC at the Movies
summary:
MSNBC at the Movies was a show from the mid-2000s, hosted by Sharon Tay, that covered the film industry with star/director interviews, behind-the-scenes info, and critic reviews, focusing on movie premieres and DVD releases

.

name: Не обмани
summary: As a result of an accident, Lyudmila's son Vladimir dies. Before he dies, he tells her that he has an illegitimate son. He wants to leave all his possessions to him. The dying man has always had a difficult, conflicted relationship with his mother. He doubts that she will comply with his request and begs: "Do not deceive ..." Lyudmila begins searching for her son's ex-girlfriend and her grandson, and during this time, meeting different people from her son's entourage, she rethinks her relationship with him.

name: Любить
summary:
Lida is so in love with the young scientist Igor that she is ready to do anything for his happiness. Even to take out a loan secured by his apartment for the sake of his postgraduate studies. Igor moves to Moscow and invites Lida with him, she drops everything and goes with him. But in the capital, Igor looked for a more profitable match - the rector's daughter, and left Lida the day she found out she was pregnant.
Hard times are beginning for Lida. She takes on any job, and fate brings her to the home of spouses Anna Arkadyevna and Vadim Yurievich. Lida gets a job as their housekeeper, and Vadim begins to show her signs of attention, which she is ready to reciprocate.…

name: Ошибка
summary: Dana Kovaleva is the director of the advertising department of a fashion company. Suddenly, she begins to receive attentions from her charming boss, Roman Savelov. True, the boss is married, but he claims that his marriage is formal: his wife is much older than him, has been living in Europe for a long time, and is also ill. Dana falls in love, and meanwhile her career is rapidly going "uphill." In a short period of time, she becomes the executive and then the CEO of the company. But just as quickly, the girl finds herself... in the dock.…

name: Дальнобойщик
summary: A young, simple-minded driver, Fedor, who has long been known as Fedyunchik, periodically earns money by illegal transportation. Because of them, he often becomes a hostage to dramatic situations. One day, the hero picks up Kostya, a teenager who ran away from an orphanage, on the highway. Kostya admits that he has a mother whom he has been planning to see for a long time. Fyodor agrees to take him to his mother, not anticipating how this road will turn out for both of them.…

name: Стая
summary: A young man named Anton, a former special forces soldier and now a bank employee, suddenly finds out that his promotion is the result of his wife's affair with the bank's director. After learning about this, Anton leaves his wife and gets a job as a ski instructor.

name: The Six Gates
summary: In the mid-Ming Dynasty, the old emperor (actually Emperor Xianzong Zhu Jianshen, played by Song Yuncheng) was in a coma, and the matter of establishing an heir was unresolved. Crown Prince Zhu Youcheng (later appointed as the heir apparent and succeeded Emperor Xianzong after his death, played by Wang Defeng) and "Prince Qi" Zhu Jianyi coveted the throne and engaged in open and covert struggles. At this time, a series of murders broke out in the capital. The court ordered the Six Doors (a government agency in Beijing) to handle the case. Shen Ziming, the head of the Six Doors (Six Gates), initially wanted to smooth things over, but actually did not want his son Shen Lixing to be involved in the court intrigue. Therefore, he tried every means to prevent his son from entering the Six Doors. However, Shen Lixing could not bear to let the truth be buried, and with his extraordinary talent, he quickly solved the case by dissecting the mystery. But after solving the case, he was drawn into an even greater power struggle, thus setting the stage for a court intrigue.

name: The Captive's War
summary: The Captive's War follows a group of prisoners who rise from the ashes of catastrophe to destroy their conqueror's society from within. It is an epic tale about the transformative power of individuality in a totalitarian world.

name: Connected: Coast to Coast
summary:
Connected: Coast to Coast will include informed, topical debate on topics from politics to pop culture, with an emphasis on the latest news and buzz in the online community.  Crowley will host from MSNBC headquarters in New Jersey, while Reagan hosts from MSNBC.com headquarters in Redmond, Washington—connecting across the U.S. and connecting cable television and the Internet in a wholly unique telecast. 

The two telecasts of "Connected: Coast to Coast" present two different takes on the day's news.  The first hour of "Connected," 12-1 p.m. (ET), will examine the news of the day as it develops, with analysis and debate.  The second hour, 5-6 p.m. (ET) will take a fresh look at the day's events, incorporating viewers' questions and issues into the debate.  "Connected" will respond directly to viewers' comments and questions, and provide the experts and analysis to help viewers get the questions they ask answered.

name: Coffee Prince
summary: A young woman who supports her mother and sister after the death of their father, To sustain their daily needs she earns a living as a tricycle driver.

name: The Cult Behind the Killer: The Andrea Yates Story
summary: When Andrea Yates drowned her five children in the family bathtub one June morning in 2001, the world was left shocked – what could make a young mother do something like that to her own children? In the wake of her confession, it was established Yates was suffering from postpartum depression and psychosis. But while understanding of her mental illness helped illuminate Andrea's struggle prior to the incident, now 25 years later, ID unravels the deeply tangled layers in which a cult can influence vulnerable individuals through manipulation and control by offering unprecedented insight into Michael Woroniecki, a rogue street preacher turned cult leader, and his connection to Andrea Yates.

name: Killer Confessions: Case Files of a Texas Ranger
summary: Texas Ranger James Holland doesn't play by the rules. He's known as a serial killer whisperer because of his unique brand of interrogation tactics in cases once considered unsolvable. Watch as killers reveal the disturbing truth behind their crimes.

name: Обет молчания
summary: After burying her mother, Irina leaves the God-forsaken provincial town for Moscow. In the capital, she meets a successful entrepreneur, George. They're having a wedding. Time passes, and Irina begins to realize that a cruel man is hiding under the mask of a loving and caring husband. Her husband is jealous of her for no reason, forbids her to communicate with old friends and even raises his hand against her...

name: Мама, я женюсь!
summary:
Lonely and disappointed Tatiana Sergeevna Rakitina works at the registry office. Every day she sees happy newlyweds and... just gets annoyed. Tatiana herself has long since stopped enjoying her work and has become a routine. She sees the whole meaning of her life only in her son Dmitry. Tatiana takes great care of him, indicating what to do and who to date, completely forgetting that the "boy" has already grown up. One day Dmitry confronts his mother with the fact that he intends to get married. This news ruins Tatiana's whole world.

She declares a real war on potential daughter-in-law Dasha. In the end, the main character manages to break up the lovers. But this does not make Dmitry happy at all. Moreover, Tatiana's thoughtless actions lead to her son being hospitalized. Now Tatiana has to correct her mistakes and reconcile the "children" again. She successfully copes with this difficult task, and at the same time gets her own "little feminine happiness", which she no longer hoped for.

name: Cei trimisi
summary: A murder in Bucharest opens the door to a much bigger mystery than it seems. Edi, a police inspector, discovers that the answers are not only in the files, but also in signs that no one else sees.
